system.description:
Action
Ritual · 1 minute
SP
1
Attribute
Automatic
Range
One unoccupied square of loose earth within 6 squares, up to 1 square deep
Duration
Instant

Loosen, shift or pile the soil into an adjacent unoccupied square. Work around buried structures and roots. The resulting earth is ordinary material.
